policy: External gates fail closed. Documentation, simulation, internal/partner-readiness scoring, or visual presentation never closes a measured, partner, clinical, field, certification, commercial-outcome, or regulatory gate. Partial evidence is retained but never counted as closure.

closures.scope_boundary: Closes implementation of the bounded PNG/JPEG digital-file triage scanner only. It does not establish universal steganography detection, attribution, decryption, or evidentiary sufficiency.
Closes the deterministic two-fixture corpus gate only: one valid clean PNG and one otherwise identical PNG with an appended WS_FIXTURE_PAYLOAD. It does not represent a broad real-world corpus.

Closes the controlled fixture-scoped false-positive benchmark: TP=1, TN=1, FP=0, FN=0, FPR=0.0 and FNR=0.0 for the included two deterministic fixtures only. No general detection-rate claim is authorized.

Closes only the fixture-scoped blind conventional frequency-diagnostic software benchmark: five synthetic hidden-frequency cases, five passes, maximum absolute frequency error 0.0 Hz at 0.25 Hz tolerance. It is not a five-repeat instrumented physical test, structural qualification, anomalous-effect result, or independent review.

Closes only a bounded simulated 0-D component/plasma extraction-model gate. The retained model passes mass conservation, beam-energy consistency, positive-current, bounded ionization/transmission and Child-Langmuir extraction-limit checks. It does not establish calibrated thrust, detailed discharge fidelity, grid erosion, neutralization, endurance, plume/charging behavior, thermal qualification, validated efficiency or spacecraft integration.

partial_evidence.supported_scope: PASS for restore into a clean independently named replacement Docker runtime and volume after complete deletion of the original source container and volume on one GitHub-hosted runner, with source/restored inventory equality, persistent marker preservation, readiness and self-test checks.
partial_evidence.excluded_scope: Does not establish physically separate-host recovery, independent failure-domain recovery, off-host/external evidence custody, site disaster recovery, hardware-failure recovery, production RTO/RPO, certification, or field readiness.

maturity_updates.scope_boundary: Promotes ION-EP from architecture to simulated only on the basis of a reproducible ideal singly charged ion electrostatic acceleration budget with explicit mass flow and power conservation. Plasma behavior, calibrated thrust, endurance, plume, charging, erosion and spacecraft integration remain open.

Promotes Stegriage from implemented software to internal test only for the retained deterministic fixture benchmark. It does not establish generalized forensic sensitivity/specificity or admissibility.

Promotes Applied Resonance from simulated to internal test only for the blind conventional frequency-diagnostic software benchmark on five synthetic signals. Five-repeat instrumented physical tests and independent review remain open.
